"We started to play DM2 and everything was looking fine, until 5 min was left of the game. Then we got a huge pl attack and were forced to break (we had a 40 frag lead and quad). So we connected to a proxy and replayed the map. The proxy helped against the pl, but we had like 120 ping most of the match. The start was pretty good. We got the first two quads, but IBH fought back and no one really had control over the map and in the end we managed to win by 15 frags. A really tight game. - FF-exile"
